Reports under:
o Web Allowed: Reports > Application & Web > Web Risks & Usage
o Web Denied: Reports > Application & Web > Blocked Web Attempts
o Also use to report:

CASB (With combination of Application Logs ): Reports > Application & Web > Cloud Application Usage

Search Engine ( Where URL has search pattern ): Reports > Application & Web > Search Engine
•
Log identifier for reports:
o Web Allowed:  Log Component = HTTP & ( Log Subtype = Allowed or Clean or Warned )
o Web Denied: Log Component = HTTP & Log Subtype = Denied
